name: Scrape edfringe shows (full)

# Full rebuild: download every show from the edfringe.com GraphQL API, normalize
# into the website-ready data files, and commit them. Run manually from the
# Actions tab. For the lightweight daily top-up see refresh.yml.

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      per:
        description: Shows per page
        required: false
        default: "50"
      min_delay:
        description: Minimum delay between requests (seconds)
        required: false
        default: "4"
      max_delay:
        description: Maximum delay between requests (seconds)
        required: false
        default: "9"
      commit:
        description: Commit the normalized data back to the repo
        type: boolean
        required: false
        default: true

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  scrape:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"

      - name: Fetch all shows from the API
        run: |
          python3 scraper/fetch_shows.py \
            --recently-added ANY \
            --per "${{ inputs.per }}" \
            --min-delay "${{ inputs.min_delay }}" \
            --max-delay "${{ inputs.max_delay }}"

      - name: Normalize into website data
        run: python3 scraper/normalize.py

      - name: Summarise
        if: always()
        run: |
          python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('data/days/index.json')); print('shows:',d['shows'],'venues:',d['venues'],'days:',len(d['dates']))" 2>/dev/null || echo "n/a"

      - name: Upload raw scrape artifact
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: edfringe-raw
          path: data/raw_pages/
          retention-days: 90
          if-no-files-found: error

      - name: Commit normalized data
        if: ${{ inputs.commit }}
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add data/normalized data/venues.json data/days
          if git diff --staged --quiet; then
            echo "No data changes to commit."
          else
            git commit -m "Update Fringe data (full scrape)"
            git push
          fi

## What & why

The full-scrape workflow (`scrape.yml` → `fetch_shows.py` → `normalize.py`) looked frozen: the CI log stayed empty for minutes and progress was unknowable ([example run](https://github.com/missingbulb/EdFringeNow/actions/runs/30029292299/job/89281563485)).

The scripts already `print` plenty. The real problem is buffering: in GitHub Actions stdout is a pipe, not a TTY, so Python **fully buffers** it and nothing is flushed until the process exits. A full scrape sleeps 4–9s between requests across ~77 pages, so the whole crawl runs silently and the output only lands at the very end.

## Changes

- **`fetch_shows.py`** and **`normalize.py`**: reconfigure `stdout`/`stderr` to line buffering at the start of `main()`, so each line is flushed as it's printed. Self-contained (works no matter how the script is launched); falls back gracefully if `reconfigure` isn't available.
- **`fetch_shows.py`** — more talkative: every progress line is prefixed with elapsed `m:ss`; page lines now report the running show total and pages fetched; and an up-front estimate of the remaining throttled-fetch time is printed once the page count is known.

## Testing

- `python3 scraper/normalize.py --selftest` — `selftest OK`
- `python3 scraper/fetch_shows.py --help` — OK
- Verified `reconfigure(line_buffering=True)` takes effect when stdout is piped (non-TTY)

No behavioural change to the scraped/normalized data — this only affects logging.

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "22"
      - name: Verify (tests + syntax)
